title: The many facets of human brain asymmetry
title_zh: 人脑不对称的多重面相
abstract: Asymmetry on the left–right axis is an organizing principle of the human brain that is important for diverse cognitive and behavioural functions. Advances in neuroimage analysis, genomics and large-scale data collection in the past decade have transformed our understanding of the biological foundations and multivariate nature of brain asymmetry. In this Review, we synthesize evidence across scales — from functional and macro-anatomical asymmetries and their inter-relations to microstructural, cellular and molecular levels. We examine inter-individual variation and atypical forms of brain asymmetry, which reveal that diverse aspects of asymmetry can vary largely independently across individuals rather than constituting a single trait. In this context, we discuss the developmental origins, lifespan trajectories and genetic architecture of hemispheric differences. We also summarize the relevance of brain asymmetry for neurological and psychiatric disorders and evolutionary changes of brain asymmetry that occurred in humans. Through this synthesis, we illustrate how contrasting the left and right hemispheres provides an informative window into the multi-level brain organization that supports cognition and behaviour. Contrasting the right and left hemisphere has undergone a methodological and conceptual transformation. In this Review, Francks and colleagues focus on brain asymmetry as a multivariate and multiscale organizational feature of the human brain while discussing its variability across individuals and how left–right asymmetry supports cognition and behaviour.
abstract_zh: 左右轴上的不对称是人脑的一种组织原则，对多种认知和行为功能至关重要。过去十年来，神经影像分析、基因组学以及大规模数据采集的进展，已深刻改变了我们对脑不对称的生物学基础及其多变量性质的理解。在本综述中，我们跨尺度整合了证据——从功能性与大解剖学不对称及其相互关系，到微结构、细胞和分子水平。我们探讨了个体间差异及非典型形式的脑不对称，这些发现揭示，不对称的各个方面在个体间大多独立变异，而非构成单一特质。在此背景下，我们讨论了半球差异的发育起源、跨寿命轨迹及遗传结构。我们还总结了脑不对称对神经系统和精神疾病的关联，以及人类脑不对称的进化变化。通过这种综合，我们展示了对比左右半球如何为支撑认知与行为的多层次脑组织提供一扇富有信息量的窗口。对比右脑与左脑已经经历方法学与概念的转变。本综述中，Francks 与同事将脑不对称作为人脑的多变量多尺度组织特征进行探讨，同时讨论其个体间的变异性，以及左右不对称如何支持认知和行为。
